nodes.description: A third branch of the ARCI cornification lesion, distinct from transglutaminase cross-linking and from epidermal lipid handling. Caspase-14 is expressed in the suprabasal epidermis and activated during keratinocyte cornification, where it performs the terminal proteolytic step that breaks filaggrin down into the free amino acids and derivatives that make up the natural moisturizing factors of the stratum corneum. Where this step fails, filaggrin fragments accumulate and natural moisturizing factors are depleted. CASP14 is the ARCI gene assigned to this branch.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in SDR9C7 gene encoding an enzyme for vitamin A metabolism underlie autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis.
evidence.snippet: Whole-exome sequencing and the subsequent Sanger sequencing led to the identification of missense mutations in short chain dehydrogenase/reductase family 9C, member 7 (SDR9C7) gene on chromosome 12q13.3, i.e. two families shared an identical homozygous mutation c.599T > C (p.Ile200Thr) and one family had another homozygous mutation c.214C > T (p.Arg72Trp).

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in SDR9C7 gene encoding an enzyme for vitamin A metabolism underlie autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis.
